description_en: Creates a Data Integration synchronization task
description_zh: 调用CreateDISyncTask创建数据集成同步任务
name: CreateDISyncTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The task type of the Data Integration synchronization task to create. The CreateDISyncTask operation supports creating offline synchronization tasks (DI_OFFLINE), real-time synchronization tasks (DI_REALTIME), and solutions (DI_SOLUTION)
parameters.help_zh:
创建的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。
目前支持使用CreateDISyncTask接口创建数据集成离线同步任务（DI_OFFLINE），实时同步任务（DI_REALTIME）和解决方案（DI_SOLUTION）
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The script content of the Data Integration synchronization task
parameters.help_zh: 数据集成同步任务的脚本内容
parameters.name: task_content

parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters of the Data Integration synchronization task. The following parameters are supported:
FileFolderPath: the storage path of the Data Integration synchronization task.
ResourceGroup: the identifier of the Data Integration resource group used by the task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html operation to obtain the resource group identifier.
Cu: the specifications occupied by the task on the serverless resource group. The value must be a multiple of 0.5.

When you create an offline synchronization task (TaskType=DI_OFFLINE), this parameter is required and must contain at least FileFolderPath
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步任务的配置参数。目前支持配置如下参数：
FileFolderPath：表示数据集成同步任务的存放路径。
ResourceGroup：表示数据集成同步任务所使用的数据集成资源组标识（Identifier）。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html，获取资源组标识。
Cu：表示数据集成同步任务在Serverless资源组上占用的规格，必须是0.5的倍数。

创建离线同步任务（TaskType=DI_OFFLINE）时，此参数实际为必填项，并且至少需要包含 FileFolderPath
parameters.name: task_param

parameters.help_en: The name of the Data Integration synchronization task to create
parameters.help_zh: 创建的数据集成同步任务的名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，该参数可为空
parameters.name: client_token

Data.description_en: The result of creating the Data Integration synchronization task
Data.description_zh: 创建数据集成同步任务的返回结果

FileId.description_en: The ID of the successfully created Data Integration synchronization task
FileId.description_zh: 成功创建的数据集成同步任务的任务ID

Message.description_en: The description of the cause of the failure to create the Data Integration synchronization task. If the task is created, this field is empty. If the task fails to be created, an example value is "Invalid directory path: Workflow/xxxx/Data Integration"
Message.description_zh: 创建数据集成同步任务失败的原因描述，如果成功，该字段为空，如果不成功，实例如下"不合法的目录路径：业务流程/xxxx/数据集成"，
Message.example: 不合法的目录路径：业务流程/xxxx/数据集成

Status.description_en:
The status of the result of creating the Data Integration synchronization task. Valid values:
success: The task is created.
fail: The task fails to be created
Status.description_zh:
创建数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示创建任务成功。
fail：表示创建任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
